ngspice.source: ngspice manual §2.11.5 "Syntax of expressions" (built-in function names) and §2.11.6 "Reserved words" (reserved words and the verbose operators not, and, or, div, mod); see docs/grammars/ngspice/specs/NG-FML-001.yaml

ltspice.source: [ltspice-ref] SIMULATION-COMMANDS-REFERENCE.md ".PARAM" (built-in constants), and the solver variable temp: the bare words LTspice gives a value by itself, settled by probe in M8 T12; a call is told apart by the grammar; see docs/grammars/ltspice/scoping.md S11

xyce.source: [xyce-ref] §2.1.26 p121 and §2.1.12 p46 ".PARAM", ".GLOBAL_PARAM" (reserved words), §2.1.10 p42 ".FUNC" (the constants PI and EXP) and Tables 2-33 and 2-34 p166-171 (built-in functions); a definition never masks a reserved word (docs/grammars/xyce/scoping.md S7). The functions are also the alternatives of BUILTIN_OPEN in xyce.lark
